{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA rows: revenue = '999999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check the status of QA rows
print("QA rows status:", qa_rows['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Count completed orders excluding QA rows
completed_count = df[~df['revenue'].eq('999999.99')]['status'].eq('completed').sum()

# Print the result
print(completed_count)"}
